name: P-001 activation audit refuses an unresolved owner-turn reference and a missing plan target
command: plans:audit { slug:'su-mode-contract-identity-unification-2026-09-24', harness:'papercusp', phase:'activation', classRef:'plan-class-feature-ship', dryRun:true } with the complete recorded payload of 13 mappings and 4 sourceRanges (baseline)

Repeat the same dryRun with one added sourceRange for the nonexistent session 00000000-0000-7000-8000-000000000001 (turns 0-1) and one added ref session_turn:codex:00000000-0000-7000-8000-000000000001:0 on M-001
Repeat the same dryRun with one added planTarget P-999 on M-001
Operator :3070 build 7708e704d9. Every call used dryRun:true, so no audit, repair, clause or event rows were written.
summary: The baseline activation audit passed validation on the complete payload. It resolved 32 source refs against plan version 47. Two single-fault variants each changed one element of that payload, and the audit refused both. An owner-turn ref to a session that does not exist was refused with source_refs_unresolved / session_turn_not_found. A mapping target P-999, which is absent from the plan, was refused with plan_targets_invalid / unknown_item. So the oracle behind this spec goes red on two of the three falsifier conditions.

assertions.evidence: Baseline dryRun returned ok:true, mappings 13, sourceRanges 4, sourceRefsResolved 32, planSnapshot version 47 contentHash 391a590bd5cec53de139521152fdc0c815efdbdf9caf6e6b277c28757a44b45d, message 'Activation audit validation passed; no audit, repair, clause, or event writes were performed.'

Adding the ref session_turn:codex:00000000-0000-7000-8000-000000000001:0, inside a declared range for that nonexistent session, returned ok:false with error source_refs_unresolved, problem code session_turn_not_found: 'could not be resolved through sessions:read's index/archive stores'. Nothing was recorded.

Adding planTarget P-999 to M-001 returned ok:false with error plan_targets_invalid, problem code unknown_item: 'M-001 targets item P-999, which is absent from the current plan revision'. No writes were performed.

Each variant differs from the baseline by exactly one added element. An earlier variant that replaced an existing ref was refused by a different rail (activation_coverage_regression / mapping_source_refs_dropped). A variant that added a ref outside every declared range was refused as source_ref_outside_range. Neither of those two is counted as evidence for the resolution check.

limitation: This does not inject the third falsifier condition, a BAR seed revision that differs from the audited revision. That is covered by the positive check in docs/evidence/p001-activation-audit-source-coverage-2026-09-26.json (barContract.subjectPlanRevision 45 equals the audited plan version 45), not by a counterexample. The plan has since moved to version 47 through status-only item changes.
